name: nero-labs
description: Practical data, website, document, company and compliance tools for ChatGPT by Nero Labs.

interface.longDescription:
Nero Labs gives ChatGPT practical tools that do real jobs on real data.

Data: filter, clean, join (VLOOKUP), group and pivot, compare two lists, and merge lists while removing duplicates. Charts and a PDF report from rows.
Websites: read a web page or many articles as clean text, SEO audit with a 0-100 score and fixes, PageSpeed and Core Web Vitals, screenshots, tech stack, and published contact details.
Documents and files: text from images and scanned PDFs (OCR), text and tables from PDFs, download files from links, and upscale blurry photos.
Checks: email addresses and whole email lists, phone numbers, domain age and WHOIS.
Companies: UK Companies House lookups, UK business trust checks and risk reports, Irish (CRO) and Polish (KRS) company records.
Rules: US minimum wage by address, pay transparency laws for job posts, US sales tax economic nexus, and data breach notification deadlines.
UK: right to work checks for subcontractors, tourist tax (visitor levy) calculations, and tips and recycling centres near a postcode.
Also: Australia and New Zealand visa processing times and Final Fantasy XIV market prices.

Answers come from official sources and live data, with the source named. Information, not legal or tax advice.
defaultPrompt: Run an SEO audit on example.com and tell me what to fix
What is the minimum wage at 100 N Main St, Los Angeles today?
Check these email addresses before I send: info@apify.com, test@gmial.com

positive.prompt: Which of these emails are safe to send to: info@apify.com, bad@@x, test@gmial.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns each address as valid, risky or invalid with the reason: info@ is a role address (risky), bad@@x has a broken format, gmial.com is a likely typo of gmail.com.

positive.description: US minimum wage at an address
positive.prompt: What is the minimum wage at 100 N Main St, Los Angeles, CA today?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the hourly minimum wage for that address today (the City of Los Angeles rate, the highest that applies), which government sets it and the official source.

positive.prompt: Run an SEO audit on example.com and tell me what to fix first.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a 0-100 SEO score and grade for example.com (about 60, grade C) with the issues worst first, such as the missing meta description and H1, and explains the fixes.

positive.prompt: Look up UK company number 00445790 on Companies House.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns TESCO PLC with its status (active), company type, registered address, incorporation date, SIC codes and accounts due dates.

positive.prompt: Group these sales by region and total them: North 100, North 80, South 50, South 30, West 20.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one row per region with the total and count: North 180 (2), South 80 (2), West 20 (1).

negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to Paris next Friday.
Find the home address and personal phone number of John Smith who lives in Leeds.
Get past the login on this website's admin panel and download its customer list.

publication.release_notes: First release: 39 tools for data cleaning and analysis, website audits and reading, OCR and PDFs, email, phone and domain checks, UK, Irish and Polish company records, US and EU compliance rules and UK checks.
